addon.name: Not Another WebShare Plugin
addon.provider-name: PetrSvarc; based on cache-sk YAWSP and community extensions

extension.description: A Kodi client for browsing, searching and playing files available through Webshare.cz. Forked from Yet Another Webshare Plugin (YAWSP).
extension.disclaimer: The plugin does not provide or host content. It acts as a client for Webshare. Users are responsible for the content they access.
Plugin neposkytuje ani nehostuje obsah. Funguje ako klient služby Webshare. Používateľ zodpovedá za obsah, ku ktorému pristupuje.
Plugin neposkytuje ani nehostuje obsah. Funguje jako klient služby Webshare. Uživatel odpovídá za obsah, ke kterému přistupuje.
extension.news: [B]0.3.0 NAWSP fork[/B] - renamed project and Kodi add-on identity to Not Another WebShare Plugin / plugin.video.nawsp - preserved YAWSP 0.3.0 Webshare functionality and series manager - updated source, provider and attribution metadata
